direction: The owner liked round 194 and asked to continue the local exterior comparison.
scope: Two local Blender exterior studies. The playable Windows build uses round 172.
method: Use the accepted gallery cameras with 64 pixels of padding on the 1152-square gallery render. Trace Glacier's port seams on the 1024-square painting and reserve separate columns for checks. Delta's sheet marks use the 1440-wide working grid of the accepted 3504-wide sheet. Sample the first physical surface under the plan, port and gallery marks, counting framing as metal. Compare native Blender geometry against a fresh GLB import.
studio: 24 Cycles samples with the same neutral lights, a second key turned 65 degrees and an emitters-only control.

glacier-tongue.name: Glacier Tongue
changed_meshes: Layered shell and recessed port wall
glacier-tongue.trial_choice: Kept the second surface pass. It clips source sampling at wedge tips and fades into base panels beyond the painted seams.
glacier-tongue.limit: The forward landing remains a simple projecting bar. The port bay and upper structures still need their own detailed geometry and finish.
